verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents customizing grouping per exception by changing the error class name, component, or stack trace, or by sending a custom fingerprint. That lets a developer make future occurrences group together or separate, approximating merge and split at reporting time. The evidence shows no in-app action to merge existing issues or split a wrongly collapsed one. Missing for 10: a documented UI/API merge of existing issues, a documented split/unmerge of collapsed issues, retroactive regrouping of past notices, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
